items.title: Joseph Rene Interview, 1960-04-07
items.q: I tell you a fella that kind of know him, but you know Slowdrag?

ctx.x: Did he play jazz, what you call ragtime? Or was he strictly a reader or what?
No, I don't think he was a reader. I just think he just, this ability, this man just had that in here. According to what, I tell you a fella that kind of know him, but you know Slowdrag?
